strongest_paths.chain: Training mix and loss masking → screen-choice disagreement (274 of 300 uncertain), pristine collapse, mirror collapse → Loss masking audit and commitment controls
strongest_paths.name: Path 1: one training defect behind three failures
strongest_paths.why: If a masking defect exists it outranks every other explanation of the two collapses and caveats every trained result. Cheapest first move, already running.

strongest_paths.chain: Screen design → similarity confound (screen AUCs 0.55 to 0.59) → Similarity audit on frozen snapshots, shared across NewsCLIPpings and VERITE
strongest_paths.name: Path 2: price the similarity explanation before training again
strongest_paths.why: Stored artifacts only, no experiment. It prices how much of the pairing reads is surface similarity before any new training is proposed.

strongest_paths.chain: Question pack wording → miscaptioned blindness (VERITE recall 0.0 in BASE and EVIDENCE) → Separate miscaptioned rescue (proposed); the direct RED-DOT pilot was killed as drafted
strongest_paths.name: Path 3: the blind class with no live intervention
strongest_paths.why: The graph exposes a gap: the only failure mode whose direct intervention is dead. The rescue avenue is the surviving route, and the relevance pilot needs its 8-point re-registration to return.
